inputs.name: helm_version
inputs.description: Helm release to install, with its v. Change checksums with it.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the Helm tarball for each architecture, from get.helm.sh/helm-VERSION-linux-ARCH.tar.gz.sha256sum.

inputs.name: releases
inputs.description: Chart releases to install, by release name. chart is a name in repository, or an oci:// reference with no repository. version is exact. values is YAML, usually from yamlencode, and reaches state, so anything secret goes in values_files: absolute paths of values files already on the host.

inputs.name: release_host
inputs.description: Which of hosts runs Helm for the releases. When null, the first name in sorted order. It needs a kubeconfig at the path in kubeconfig.

inputs.name: kubeconfig
inputs.description: Path on the release host of the kubeconfig Helm uses. The default is where k3s writes its own.
